comment: No source is published and no documentation is shipped. The panel prints RATE, WAVE, FM LEVEL, MULTI over SINGLE, OUTPUTS, and the jacks SYNC, FM IN, WAVE CV and PHASE CV; none of the jacks has a maker's name. The eight outputs are laid out clockwise around the panel from the top, output 0 at the top and output 4 at the bottom. The WAVE range of 0 to 7 corroborates the eight waveforms, and RATE running -1 to 1 is what the line about direction rests on, together with the maker's feature list, which has manual selection of phase shift direction. The 45 degree spread at 0V of phase CV is the maker's own figure. Unipolar Mode is the maker's own name. Deliberately not written: any rate figure, because the maker's 0.03Hz to 30Hz is a hardware specification and the plugin's mapping could not be read; and whether the centre of the RATE knob stops the LFO, which the hardware's freeze function suggests but nothing here confirms.
